messages:
maria: Noticing a surge of stream disconnects on eu-edge for the last 40m. Proxy logs show delayed ACKs causing router to evict leases and trigger route swaps; clients reconnect and we see resume_id mismatches leading to duplicate billing. Ops alerted.
kevin: Any recent routing or proxy rollout around that time? can you paste a log snippet? @june
june: We rolled out route-policy v2 to eu at 15:55 yesterday, canary -> 50%. The main change was sticky-lease timeout reduction for hot shards.
maria: Minimal logs (sanitized):
```
[eu-proxy-12] 2026-03-23T16:05:12Z INFO ack_delayed route_swap=true session=abc123 resume=RID-456 cost=1
[router-6] 2026-03-23T16:05:13Z WARN lease_evicted session=abc123 shard_old=s-09 shard_new=s-22
[ingest] 2026-03-23T16:05:14Z ERROR client_reconnect id=cid-890 code=1006
```
maria: Explanation: proxy buffers an ACK until a late frame arrives; sticky lease timeout (shorter in v2) fires first -> router flips route -> resume token invalidated -> reconnect consumes a fresh resume and billing counts twice.
telemetry-bot: Quick correlate: region=eu & policy=v2 shows connect_failures +4.6x since 15:58.
june: v2 changed sticky-lease from 30s to 8s for high-util shards to free capacity. That likely opened the window.
kevin: Two areas to address: (1) Console/telemetry blind spot: we don't surface late ACKs or lease evictions prominently. (2) Billing guardrail: avoid double-charge on quick resume/reconnect loops.
telemetry-bot: Suggested short actions: add streaming.late_ack_rate and streaming.lease_eviction_rate metrics (per-region, per-policy) and a dashboard tile in staging. Backfill query: SELECT count(*) FROM stream_events WHERE region='eu' AND event IN ('ack_delayed','lease_evicted','resume_mismatch') AND ts >= '2026-03-23T15:50:00Z';
june: For immediate rollback: revert sticky-lease timeout for the canary cohort to 30s. I'll open a rollback PR.
maria: Short-term mitigation: patch router to apply a 2s grace when seeing an ack_delayed event before evicting a lease. Can we hotpatch? Need tests.
kevin: Also add a billing safety: if resume_count for a session >1 within 10s, flag as suspect and hold billing pending review. Ops/finance must approve.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260323-89 created: "eu-edge late-ack lease evictions causing reconnects & duplicate billing". Pager duty notified.
telemetry-bot: Actions tracked: (1) backfill query (done), (2) new metrics + staging dashboard, (3) router grace patch + tests, (4) temporary billing hold for resume duplicates.
maria: I'll collect session traces and attach to the incident. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
